thread:
harper: paging — spike of failed token-exchange requests for svc-collector in us-west-2 starting ~2026-03-15T22:12:01Z. lots of 401/429s, followed by unusual S3 ListBucket attempts. tagging secops and infra. @pagerduty
incident-bot: P-2 incident created: INC-2026-4987 10:15 UTC 1: primary oncall @devon
devon: taking this. quick triage question: are these genuine failed attempts or token reuse? any successes? can we short-circuit the token-exchange endpoint for that role?
secops: initial findings: repeated exchanges from three CIDR blocks (34.210.12.0/24, 3.120.45.0/24, 44.55.66.77 single IP). Found sequence: token-exchange -> assume-role -> s3:ListBucket on bucket redwood-debugging-stash. Some list calls succeeded, some returned 403. No customer buckets in the list so far.
nina: i'm on infra. collecting live sessions and will run immediate session revocation for svc-collector. also prepping WAF rule.
harper: logs snippet (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-15T22:12:18Z] svc-collector token-exchange ip=34.210.12.45 session=zzzabc result=200 ua=python-requests/2.28
[2026-03-15T22:12:45Z] s3.ListBucket bucket=redwood-debugging-stash prefix=tmp/ ip=34.210.12.45 result=200 items=8
[2026-03-15T22:13:10Z] s3.GetObject bucket=redwood-debugging-stash key=debug-logs/trace-20260314.log ip=44.55.66.77 result=403
```
devon: ok treat as possible leak. immediate actions: 1) revoke active sessions for svc-collector 2) rotate role/session policy 3) add WAF block on offending IPs and rate-limit token-exchange 4) preserve forensic copies of any accessed objects 5) notify support/legal.
infra-bot: revocation job queued by nina @ 1769654350
infra-bot: revocation job complete 10:25 UTC 1: 64 sessions revoked for role svc-collector at 1769654380
secops: snapshotting suspicious objects to secops-forensics/encrypted/176965/ with restricted ACLs. tagging legal.
legal-bot: legal looped in: Evidence retained, please include a minimal set of logs for review.
support-lead: assigning @support-lead to draft customer-facing note. early draft: "We detected anomalous activity in an internal debug store. We have revoked implicated sessions and rotated credentials. No evidence of customer data access at this time." Need secops confirmation before sending.
nina: applying WAF block for IPs 34.210.12.45, 44.55.66.77 and CIDR 3.120.45.0/24. Adding rate-limit 25r/min per ip for /v1/token-exchange.
infra-bot: WAF rule applied at 1769654422 10:27 UTC
devon: starting credential rotation now. commands executed (redacted):
```
# create replacement role policy and attach
aws iam create-policy --policy-name svc-collector-rotate-20260315 --policy-document file://svc-collector-rotate.json
# update token-exchange to reject old session-nonce
kubectl set env deploy/token-exchange REJECT_OLD_NONCE=true -n infra
# control-plane revoke
curl -X POST "https://control.redwood.internal/api/revoke_sessions" -d '{"role":"svc-collector","since":"2026-03-15T22:10:00Z"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
infra-bot: token-exchange deployment rolled (rotation flag) at 1769654480 10:34 UTC 1: 4/4 pods ready
secops: forensic team found partial bearer tokens in two debug files. redacted copies saved for legal. marking as potential sensitive-data exposure (internal logs).
devon: run a smoke test of customer-facing APIs please.
infra-bot: smoke tests run at 1769654600 10:43 UTC 1: all core routes returned 200 within SLOs; no customer-facing regressions detected.
support-lead: revised customer note with secops approval: "We detected anomalous access to an internal debug bucket. We have revoked sessions, rotated credentials for the implicated service account, and have not found evidence of customer data access. We will follow up when forensics complete." preparing outbound channel and support script.
secops: recommended follow-ups: full forensic timeline, rotate KMS keys if any evidence of key material in logs, audit CI/dev workflows that might cause creds to be logged, tighten bucket ACLs and logging, update runbooks, and consider automated redaction for debug logging.
devon: handoff plan: i'll stay on high-priority watch for 2 hours; primary rotates off in 45m - @nina will take next oncall. pagerduty: escalation note: primary acknowledged, secondary @nina available.
harper: post-incident summary will be posted in #incidents with timeline and artifacts reference. creating ticket INC-2026-4987-PII for legal review.
legal-bot: confirmed intake created and reviewing redacted artefacts.
secops: current classification P-2 with potential internal-data exposure; no confirmed customer exfiltration. will update within 3 hours or on material changes.
